proposition.claim:
Recorded check: No-prefactor real-time domination fails

Hypotheses: Every time-one map has stable norm lambda^{-1}<1/2 and sectional area expansion lambda>1 on Fcu. The normal stable/unstable ratio gains lambda^2. Uniform estimates for arbitrary positive time retain a fixed prefactor bounded in terms of ||h||, so sectional hyperbolicity and domination hold. Orthogonality is exactly as assumed in the paper. There are no singularities, hence Wr is empty.
